review_description: The quotes were really cheaper than any other providers. Dom do not subcontract so he has his men along with him to do the installation. The job was very professional, tidy and quick.For the past 5 months my electricity bill has been zero with a credit of around AUD 33 currently,  which is awesome for me.

Don was fast to come back to me with several options and quotes.  Once I selected the correct system Installation date was booked in, Don and his team arrived  and installed the system over 2 days.  Install was neat and tidy  (I had an independant sparky asses the work).  Commucation was exellent and I was kept informed with any issues and progress along the way.   Don uses his own staff for installation which was important to me (Some companies just farm out your business to contractors for the lowest rate).   After installation service has been good as I had a few questions once the system was in place and Don was very responsive.

We are very pleased with the competitive quote and high standard installation of our solar system provided by Softwave Building Solutions .  Don was very accommodative, willing to supply quotes for a number of different configurations and to visit our site. He was also flexible with the installation and his crew did a great job with the delivery, installation and clean up.  I have recommended Softwave Building solutions to my son for his solar installation, and will also use them when we have any air conditioning/heating needs.   Thanks again Don.

Did a lot of research, went through a lot of retailers and Installers to finally land upon a deal with SOFTWAVE BUILDING SOLUTIONS PTY LTD (Don was great!). Initial reference was through Solar Quotes, I was very hesitant to go with Don as he just did not have any reviews in Google. I generally go with an established retailer for an investment like Solar Panels, but my thoughts quickly changed after couple of phone conversations with Don! He spent quality time on explaining the reasons why I should consider him versus an established Retailer, in the end I was convinced.I was very specific for 6.6 kW system. Q-Cells DUO-G5+ 330 with Fronius Primo 5.0-1 Invertor. Don's Quote was much detailed, and he spent a good amount of time in reworking the various options I was interested in (I was initially keen to go with additional panels and limiter for feed-in etc.,) his calculations helped me decide the return on investment! His Quote was much cheaper than other quotes I have received. for me the other retailer discussion purely looked like a sales pitch!To summarize:- Has no prior work reviews for reference (on the internet as reviews). [My reply after installation - I was very glad I picked up Don's team vs other retailers. very clean job and attention to detailed was given by the team). The reason for not having reviews in the internet is purely due to Don not focussing on that area much. At this moment his team has done 110+ solar installations on their own (they have been an Installer for a long time for another retailer).- He quoted much lesser than the established retailer. [My reply] - He is installer, a retailer has a lot of overhead (which will result in a higher cost). Retailers employ installers end of the day!- The name of the company did not sound related to Solar (at least to me). [My Reply] - Don mentioned his intent is to also pitch in the broader Electrical business. In that he mentioned he would always be around to look at the warranty unlike retailer who would close after the subsidy goes off! [I am not sure if I am correct in this thought, just my view].I should also mention the cons.Don provided attention to detail work in terms of Installation (great job). but he was not strong with the Mobile App setup. But he patiently tried to setup the app for more than 60 mins but left without a luck as it got dark. Was little disappointed! But since I am from the IT background, I was able to manage the setup after a lot of attempts.In the end I found out Fronius invertor has a very bad Wi-Fi reception, it worked smooth after moving the Router closer. And accessing the Invertor through local network to configure the rest. Who worries about the APP on mobile, itâ€™s the installation of panels which is important!I am writing the review a week after the installation; the inspector came the very next day after the installation and the 2nd day Don has submitted my application to my energy retailer.Don's Team did an excellent job!! no regrets in working with them, will recommend them to my friends!
